The '''Carl Hodgesville Dude Ranch''' was a popular tourist spot on the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bar Neth]].<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Carl Hodgesville Dude Ranch, mentioned in an advertisement in the [[Tourscan]], was named after [[Wikipedia:Carl Hodges|Carl Hodges]], director of the Environmental Research Lab at the [[Wikipedia:University of Arizona|University of Arizona]]. He helped the team working on the Mesa Verde segment create a futuristic, yet plausible, environment.<ref name="Epcot">{{WebCite|url=http://progresscityusa.com/2011/09/01/the-horizons-story-part-iii-disneys-house-of-magic|text=The Horizons Story, Part III: Disney's House Of Magic|work=Progress City, U.S.A.|archivedate=20110924203238}}</ref> Hodges' research aim at creating vast saltwater irrigated farms along the world's desert coasts.<ref name="VF">{{WebCite|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/news/2007/04/hodges200704|text=The Future's Farmer|work=Vanity Fair|archivedate=20160413183229}}</ref>
